snippet.title: Unidentified Feline Obliterators: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390730/Unidentified_Feline_Obliterators/

In the middle of space, there exists UFOs (Unidentified Feline Obliterators). They propel themselves with deadly balls of matter. Their natural predators are the jetpack dogs, treadmill porcupines, and rocket rats. But what else is out there in space out to get these cats?

Website: https://shatteredjournalgames.com/
Discord: https://shatteredjournalgames.com/discord
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ShatteredJGames
